integrity: The sharp lower bound is proved from the complete subalgebra structure of Boolean algebras of sizes two and four. An explicit eight-element normal closure operator supplies the matching counterexample. The labelled and isomorphism counts are obtained by exhaustive direct checking of every unary operation and every relevant congruence, with a Burnside cross-check. The recent primary paper was inspected at its CEP definition, finite Boolean-frame example, discriminator/CEP results, and non-elementarity theorem; the earlier no-CEP paper was compared for stronger finite coverage.
scientific_limitations: The exact enumeration is confined to unary expansions of the eight-element Boolean algebra. The four-class refinement is for normal order-theoretic closure operators only. CEP is assessed for each algebra itself, not automatically for the variety it generates.
title: Eight elements are the sharp finite CEP threshold for Boolean frames
